response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, and a proven track record in distributed systems and open-source tooling, but lacks demonstrable leadership in scaling AI-driven fintech teams, regulatory compliance experience, or direct production deployment of multi-agent systems in financial contexts — critical gaps for a CTO role in this domain.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and low-latency backend systems
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication through workshops and public projects
concerns: No evidence of leading engineering teams beyond 10 people or developing senior technical leadership layers
Lacks documented experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulated AI deployment
No clear track record in designing model-agnostic, auditable AI systems with feedback loops for financial decisioning
